name: Spirit of the Wind
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers travelers a swift crossing of the Barrens through Agamaggan’s blood shards. His ritual lends them the speed to pass through the plains.

sections.title: A Gift from Blood Shards
sections.body: The Barrens are easier to cross quickly, before its beasts and centaur warbands find you. At Camp Taurajo, the captive quilboar Mangletooth draws on red crystalline blood shards scattered across the region. Bring him ten, and he channels their lingering power into a burst of swiftness called the Spirit of the Wind.

sections.title: Agamaggan's Ancient Breath
sections.body: Quilboar honor Agamaggan, the Great Boar whose blood spilled across central Kalimdor during the ancient War of the Ancients. Though held captive, Mangletooth knows the rites that channel that blood. His ritual stirs wild vigor, lending a runner speed to match the zhevra herds. The quilboar are bitter enemies of the Horde, yet Mangletooth shares Agamaggan's boons with travelers who bring him fresh shards.

faq.q: What is the Spirit of the Wind?
aliases: what is spirit of the wind
faq.answer: The Spirit of the Wind is a brief blessing Mangletooth grants at Camp Taurajo. Bring him ten blood shards, and he lends you speed to cross the Barrens.

faq.q: Who offers the Spirit of the Wind?
aliases: who gives spirit of the wind
who turns in blood shards for speed
faq.answer: Mangletooth offers the blessing. The Horde holds him prisoner at Camp Taurajo, where he performs the ritual when you earn his cooperation.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth require blood shards?
aliases: what does mangletooth do with shards
faq.answer: Blood shards are crystalline fragments of Agamaggan's spilled blood. Mangletooth draws on the ancient demi-god's primal power within them to weave his boons.

faq.q: Can I receive this blessing more than once?
aliases: is spirit of the wind repeatable
can i do this quest again
faq.answer: Yes. Bring Mangletooth ten blood shards each time, and he can channel the blessing whenever you return.

faq.q: Why would a quilboar help members of the Horde?
faq.answer: Mangletooth is captive at Taurajo. He bargains his ancestral knowledge of Agamaggan's magic for survival, dealing with travelers who gather the sacred shards he values.

faq.q: How long does the blessing last?
faq.answer: The blessing fades before long. Mangletooth's enchantment lends you enough swiftness to ease your travel across the Barrens for a time.

angles.text: At Camp Taurajo, guards watch Mangletooth closely. Horde scouts use his knowledge of blood shard magic to cross the southern plains faster.
As a druid, you may find the lingering power of the Wild God Agamaggan in these rites a raw expression of primeval nature.
As a shaman, you may hear an echo of your traditions in communing with the wind through crystallized divine essence. The rites honor elemental and ancestral forces.
